The '''Queen Mother's Special Salon''' was a private complex of the [[Queen Mother]] of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]. It was located on [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] in the [[Fountain Palace]], connected to the [[Royal Hangar]].
